answer.short: $(-1,-2),\ (0,0),\ (1,2)$. Solid line on the common graph.
answer.worked: Substitute $x=-1, 0, 1$ into $y=2x$ to obtain $y=-2, 0, 2$. Plot $(-1,-2),\ (0,0),\ (1,2)$ and draw the line on the same axes as the other parts.

answer.short: $(-1,-3),\ (0,-1),\ (1,1)$. Dashed line on the common graph.
answer.worked: Substitute $x=-1, 0, 1$ into $y=2x-1$ to obtain $y=-3, -1, 1$. Plot $(-1,-3),\ (0,-1),\ (1,1)$ and draw the line on the same axes as the other parts.

answer.short: $(-1,-1),\ (0,1),\ (1,3)$. Dotted line on the common graph.
answer.worked: Substitute $x=-1, 0, 1$ into $y=2x+1$ to obtain $y=-1, 1, 3$. Plot $(-1,-1),\ (0,1),\ (1,3)$ and draw the line on the same axes as the other parts.

answer.short: $(-1,2),\ (0,4),\ (1,6)$. Dash-dot line on the common graph.

answer.short: $(-1,1),\ (0,3),\ (1,5)$. Dash-dot-dot line on the common graph.
